branding.heroKicker: Washington archive - capital-city branding changes and hard-running title teams
branding.heroText: This site is a fan-built database documenting every Washington Commanders game from 1932 through 2025. Boston roots, Gibbs championships, and modern rebrand years without losing the franchise arc.

franchiseSummary.intro: This site is a fan-built database documenting every Washington Commanders game from 1932 through 2025. Boston roots, Gibbs championships, and modern rebrand years without losing the franchise arc.
